performance.cable-capacity-basis: front channel: Cat 6 24 AWG, 0.235 in (5.97 mm), at the 30% recommended fill of its 9.8 sq in usable area; 112 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Space-Saving Cable Management Rack Systems bulletin RKCB46, Cable Capacity Charts
performance.cable-capacity-rear-basis: rear channel: Cat 6 24 AWG, 0.235 in (5.97 mm), at the 30% recommended fill of its 11.1 sq in usable area; 127 at the 50% maximum fill - the same bulletin, which notes the rear section may be partially blocked by rack posts

physical.mounting-hardware: #12-24 mounting screws, as shipped with the covers

configs.description: The manager as Panduit ships NM2, both covers fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with both covers opened, the finger walls, the D-rings and the channels open to lay a cable in. The covers come with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: the specification sheet says the dual hinged covers open 110 degrees to the top or bottom without being removed; no view draws a hinge. Each cover carries five stand-in hinge knuckles on its top edge and on its bottom edge (their count, size and place are estimated) and is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of a cover's hinge

gaps.note: the plan view draws the five rear posts but no view draws the loop they belong to: the bars' thickness and the hook's extent are estimated, and so is the ring's opening, from the usable area the calculator states.
gaps.wanted: a side view or a section through the rear channel

gaps.note: the NM2B front-to-rear pass-through blanking panel is a separate accessory (V10404BT-DC) that closes the two windows; it is not drawn and the windows are open.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the blanking panel fitted

gaps.note: no view sections the covers or the fingers: their thickness is estimated and the elevations draw the body without the covers' edges.
gaps.wanted: a section through a cover and a finger tip
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the NM2 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP237); the temperatures are the customer drawing's.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger tips along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Charts of the Space-Saving bulletin (RKCB46) give the NM2 per cable at the 30 per cent recommended fill and the 50 per cent maximum, the front and the rear separately; the figures stated are the Cat 6 24 AWG 0.235 in (5.97 mm) column at 30 per cent: 67 front (112 at 50 per cent) and 76 rear (127). The Cable Capacity Calculator gives the usable areas, 9.8 and 11.1 sq in. The bulletin notes the rear section may be partially blocked by rack posts.

chassis.note: estimated - 444.83 x 88 x 332. The drawing dimensions 482 [19.0 in] over the ears, 465 [18.3 in] between the fixing holes, 88 [3.5 in] high and 332 [13.1 in] deep; the body between the ears is the NCMH2 drawing's 444.83 [17.51 in] for the same moulding, which the NM2 drawing does not give. The ears are not drawn.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the covers are drawn a shade lighter than the moulding.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The NM2 customer drawing (Panduit 10404-20) dimensions the front channel "5.5 REF [140]" from the front of the cover to the end of the finger zone and the whole manager "13.1 REF [332]"; the NMF2's "6.2 REF [157]" puts the plate and flange 17.3 behind the channel, and the rear channel is the 175 behind that. `at` is 139.7, so the ears bolt to the front face of the plate. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front with the cover fitted: the cover, and under it the two rows of T fingers end-on, the channel between them and the two windows in the plate at the back of it. The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger rows, 68 high (the 88 less two 10 mm rows, estimated).

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the part is 332 deep with 139.7 of it in front of the rails and 192.3 behind them; it does not reach the rear rails of a rack 600 mm deep or more, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: estimated - the front duct is the channel between the two finger rows, run across the rack, pitch 34.925 and gap 5.4 as on the NMF2; each rear ring's opening is the rear usable area Panduit's calculator gives (11.1 sq in) divided by the 68 clear height.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn. The end of the manager is the rear loops' top and bottom bars and hook, the plate, and the front finger rows' walls, built from the plan view and the front view.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS. Panduit publishes the NM2 as a customer drawing (PDF 10404-20, with a DXF and a DWG that hold only a trimetric projection of the model, not orthographic views, so they give no measurement), the NetManager High Capacity specification sheet RKSP237, a product page, the Space-Saving bulletin RKCB46 and the Cable Capacity Calculator. The customer drawing's front view and plan are read at 300 dpi against its own 482 [19.0 in] dimension. THE FIGURES THE DRAWING DIMENSIONS ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURE (the finger and ring counts and pitch, the crossbar, the windows) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

rear.note: estimated - the rear channel from behind: the rear cover, and under it the five D-rings standing out of the plate's back, 107 apart with the middle one on the centre line, each a loop with a hook at the far end. The plan view draws the five posts; their cross section is not drawn (see `gaps:`). The two windows are open in its floor.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX. The body is a sheet body (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4) and its six views are elevations. The solid is what its parts build: the plate on the front view as a well 139.7 deep with the two fingers walls and the cover in it; on the rear view the plate's back as a well 175 deep with the five D-rings and the rear cover in it; both floors open at the two windows.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the plan view, rear at y=0: the five posts 175 long, the plate and flange 17.3 deep, then the front channel's twelve stems 100 mm long with a crossbar on each tip. Read at 300 dpi; the stem and crossbar sizes are estimated.

weight.note: drawing - 1134 g [2.5 lb], the weight table of the NM2 customer drawing (10404-20).
